name: 🐛 Bug
description: Report something in the homelab that's broken or behaving wrong.

attributes.value:
Thanks for filing a bug. Fill in what you can — a clear "what happened vs.
what you expected" plus the steps to reproduce get it fixed fastest. Once Dr K adds
`agent`, the debug agent looks into it, in the code and the live homelab, and reports
here.

options.label: I searched the open issues and this isn't a duplicate.

attributes.label: What happened?
attributes.description: The actual behavior — what went wrong.
attributes.placeholder: e.g. `kubectl up apps/postgresql` rolls the StatefulSet but the pod CrashLoops on start.

attributes.label: Steps to reproduce
attributes.description: How to make it happen again, step by step.

attributes.label: Where? (app / node / component)
attributes.description: The project(s) involved, plus the environment or image tag if relevant.

attributes.label: Logs / output
attributes.description: Relevant logs, errors, or `kubectl` output. Automatically formatted as code.

attributes.label: Anything else?
attributes.description: Screenshots, links, recent changes, or anything else that helps.
